sounds.name: Startup
sounds.when: Powering on. The sonic logo: three rising notes, like a page opening.

sounds.name: Ready
sounds.when: Attached and the page is in view; ready to listen.

sounds.name: Page captured
sounds.when: A page has settled and been captured. Soft paper click.

sounds.name: Explainer voice next
sounds.when: Before any AI explanation, so it never sounds like the book.

sounds.name: Listening
sounds.when: Ask is held: the microphone is on.

sounds.name: Stopped listening
sounds.when: Ask released: the microphone is off.

sounds.name: Reminder
sounds.when: Before a spoken reminder. Three gentle notes.

sounds.name: Something's wrong
sounds.when: Low tone, always followed by a short spoken instruction.

sounds.name: Battery low
sounds.when: Two falling notes, then the device says how much is left.
